verdict.rule: CLEAN if combined p <= clean_max (the human 75th percentile) and no layer flagged; FLAGGED if combined p >= flag_min, >= 2 layers flagged, or the detector layer is flagged; else BORDERLINE.

note: Calibrated on ../../corpus/calib_corpus.jsonl (120 human / 120 AI). Values outside this register/length range are less meaningful.
